title: Sunita Kapoor v. Max Insurance Co
text: The complainant, Sunita Kapoor, filed this consumer complaint against Max Insurance Co for wrongful repudiation of her health insurance claim. The complainant was hospitalised for a cardiac procedure and submitted all documents for cashless claim settlement. The insurance company repudiated the claim alleging a pre-existing condition. The NCDRC examined the medical records and the policy documents. The condition for which hospitalisation occurred was not covered by the exclusion clause as the complainant had disclosed all material facts at the time of proposal. Repudiation of a genuine claim amounts to deficiency in service and unfair trade practice under the Consumer Protection Act. The complainant is awarded compensation of Rs 8,50,000 being the claim amount, plus Rs 2,00,000 for mental agony. The NCDRC directs the insurance company to pay within 30 days with interest.
